name: Do I need a permit for mobile home renovations or repairs in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for mobile home renovations or repairs in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you need a permit for mobile home renovations or repairs in Daly City depends on the scope and nature of the work. Minor cosmetic changes typically do not require permits. However, structural modifications, significant electrical or plumbing alterations, additions, or major foundation work will likely require permits from the City of Daly City's building department. City Dweller, LLC can assist in determining permit requirements for your specific project and guide you through the application process to ensure compliance with local regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are usually required for structural, electrical, plumbing, or foundation work on mobile homes in Daly City, but not for minor cosmetic changes.
